questions.question: What does Proverbs 29 say happens where there is no prophetic vision?
options: The people prosper and grow rich
Kings rise to rule the land

questions.question: What does Proverbs 29 say the fear of man brings?
options: A wisdom far beyond even that of the elders
A great and lasting honor among one's neighbors
A snare, but whoever trusts in the LORD is safe
A sure and lasting safety from every kind of danger
questions.answer: A snare, but whoever trusts in the LORD is safe

questions.question: Proverbs 29 says the rod and reproof give wisdom, but a child left to himself brings shame to his mother.
Where there is no prophetic vision the people cast off _____.
The fear of man is a snare, but whoever trusts in the LORD is set securely on _____.
